sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: 12 months of operations, maintenance, support, infrastructure, audits/oversight metrics, and continued development for the Eternl Cardano light wallet.

Deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for browser extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channel, Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano node operation, DBSync indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, Hub backend services, and monitoring, User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public community channels, project support, wiki maintenance, and educational videos, Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation, Independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027
Deadline/expiry: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
Claim (adoption, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, calculated at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs.
Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The funded work covers 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Claim (adoption, proposer_asserted, high materiality): Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.

Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): If roughly 5,500 users, or about 4.2% of the stated install base, buy the planned Pro plan, that income would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.

Claim (economic, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The team will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
